breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory instructions for calculating the Euler load: one using L (π^2 E I / L^2) and one using the effective length K*L (π^2 E I / (K L)^2). The ground truth removed the incorrect instruction. The generated specification successfully resolved this by only including the correct formula: P_cr = π² × E × I / (K × L)², thus eliminating the contradiction.
